acceptance_gates: Certified lower bound does not exceed exact ergotropy beyond tolerance

Empirical confidence coverage fails preregistered criterion
Invalid observables or model mismatch are accepted as valid
Monotonicity claim fails when the stated retained-unitary safeguard is applied
